name: footer-columns
title: Column footer
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A brand block with description and action beside titled link columns, over a bottom bar for copyright, legal links and a credit.

meta.useWhen: The site has enough pages that a footer sitemap genuinely helps visitors.
meta.avoidWhen: There are fewer than six links in total. Use footer-minimal.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/FooterColumns.astro. In a Site Boulder site, render it from SiteFooter.astro and pass the existing credit link.
